text: One condition. No names in anything I read. If someone clicks, that's my training's fault, not theirs.
style: Managing director who founded a small British firm, early sixties, white Scottish. Speak with a consistent soft Edinburgh Scottish accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Lower-mid pitch; unhurried, careful pace. Courteous and a little formal: a client who has agreed to the test and wants it done properly.
